title: Fastener Hole — Cold Expansion Rework in Pressurised Shell Structure
abstract: Cold expansion rework of a fastener hole in pressurised shell structure, covering the applicability check, the split sleeve process, the interference fit installation and the post-expansion inspection.

sections.purpose: This task gives the procedure to cold expand a fastener hole in pressurised shell structure, the checks that establish whether the hole is within the declared applicability, and the inspection that must follow.
sections.job_setup_note: The operator must hold a current qualification against the coupon set before this task is used. The mandrel and split sleeve must match the hole diameter; the split sleeve is single use and must be discarded after each expansion. The declared diameter range is 4.8 mm to 9.5 mm, and a hole that has already been reamed oversize is outside the declared applicability and must not be expanded. The applicability check is part of the task, not a precondition to be assumed.
sections.procedure: 1. Confirm that the operator qualification is current and record the qualification reference. 2. Measure the hole diameter and the edge distance, and confirm both are within the declared applicability. CAUTION: A HOLE PREVIOUSLY REAMED OVERSIZE IS OUTSIDE THE STANDARD. DO NOT EXPAND IT. REPORT IT FOR REPAIR ASSESSMENT. 3. Confirm that the hole has not already been expanded twice; the record is in the aircraft structural repair record. 4. Clean the hole and remove all burrs from both faces. 5. Select the mandrel and the split sleeve for the measured diameter. 6. Lubricate the mandrel and fit the split sleeve. 7. Insert the mandrel from the entry face given in the figure and draw it through in one continuous stroke. WARNING: DO NOT STOP THE MANDREL PART WAY THROUGH THE HOLE. A PARTIAL EXPANSION LEAVES A STEP THAT CANNOT BE REMOVED AND THE PART MUST BE REPLACED. 8. Discard the split sleeve. 9. Ream the hole to the interference fit dimension for the fastener. 10. Do the eddy current inspection of the expanded hole and record the result. 11. Install the interference fit fastener wet, and at a pressure boundary install the sealing washer. 12. Restore the surface protection on both faces.
sections.close_out: Record the expansion in the aircraft structural repair record, including the location, the measured diameter, the mandrel reference and the eddy current result. This record is what any later inspection interval claim depends on, so an unrecorded expansion is treated as if it had not been done.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft. Applicable only where the location and diameter are within the declared standard introduced by MOD-148640.

safety_precautions: Confirm the operator qualification before you start.
Wear eye protection during the expansion stroke.
Support the structure behind the hole before the mandrel is drawn.
